review.reviewedBy: Repository writer/admin approval recorded externally under issue #141
review.rationale: Temporary exception for the exact moderate-or-higher advisory set and normalized npm installation paths captured in the reviewed baseline. CI verifies a matching external approval from a GitHub repository writer or administrator under issue #141 before accepting this policy. The policy digest binds the advisory identities, path-aware advisory digest, expiry date, severity threshold, and tracking issue; any advisory, path, expiry, threshold, or issue change invalidates both the in-repository digest and external approval and must fail closed until explicitly reviewed again.
